bullets.text: Azure AI Superfactory Unveiled - **Microsoft** launches the world's first planet-scale AI superfactory in Atlanta, enhancing AI compute capabilities.
Windows 11 Build Released - **Microsoft** rolls out Build 22631.6269 to the Release Preview Channel, featuring quality improvements.
AI Transformation Insights - **Microsoft** reveals that Frontier firms achieve three times higher returns by leveraging AI effectively.
Security Initiative Progress - **Microsoft** reports advancements in its Secure Future Initiative, enhancing security across platforms.
New Cyberattack Discovered - **Microsoft** identifies a novel side-channel attack on remote language models, raising privacy concerns.
